guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Ethena App
guide.description: Go to the Ethena app and click “Connect Wallet.” Ethena supports MetaMask, WalletConnect, and other major Ethereum wallets. Make sure you are on Ethereum mainnet, since staking happens on the production network.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Acquire Stablecoins or ENA
guide.description: You need stablecoins to mint USDe, and optionally ENA to stake for the highest base multiplier. If you do not already hold these, buy them from Binance and withdraw to your wallet: USDT, USDC, DAI, or FRAX to mint USDe ENA to stake and lock as sENA Keep some ETH on hand for gas.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint USDe
guide.description: Open the “Buy” section in the Ethena app and swap your stablecoins for USDe. Holding USDe starts accruing Sats automatically.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake USDe for sUSDe
guide.description: Navigate to the “Stake” section and convert USDe into sUSDe. This earns protocol yield from funding rates on top of your Sats.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake and Lock ENA for sENA
guide.description: Go to the staking section, stake your ENA to receive sENA, then lock it. Locking sENA carries one of the strongest Sats multipliers in the program (reported around 40x), and longer lock durations increase the boost. Locked sENA also accrues points for partner ecosystems including Ethereal , Derive, and Echelon.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deploy Into Partner Protocols
guide.description: Route your USDe and sUSDe through integrated DeFi platforms to stack additional multipliers. Options include: Pendle USDe markets, which have offered the highest reported boosts (up to 60x) USDe/sUSDe liquidity pools for roughly 30x Yield vaults such as Strata and Ethereal, also around 30x Check current multipliers in the app before committing, since rates shift between partners and seasons.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Farm Cross-Chain on Solana and Avalanche
guide.description: USDe works beyond Ethereum, and activity on other chains qualifies for points and ecosystem rewards. Bridge USDe using a service like the bridge below, then connect a Solana or Avalanche wallet on the Sats page to keep earning across networks. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the brid
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Your Sats and Claim at Season End
guide.description: Monitor your accumulated Sats on the Ethena dashboard during the season. When Season 6 closes, return to the official claim portal, connect the same wallet, and claim your ENA. Keep ETH available for the claim transaction.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
